verdict.rationale: Sentry's agent-monitoring docs cover tracing, conversation replay, LLM call comparison, and cost and latency dashboards. Nothing in the evidence documents running evals, in CI or otherwise, or gating deployments on eval results. The official CLI and release/PR incident mapping are adjacent features, not an eval-gating capability, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results
